This would explain why you can survive Hemisphere Transplant but not My Division.

My Division. My body is fatally injured, as are the brains of my two brothers. My brain is divided, and each half is successfully transplanted into the body of one of my brothers. Each of the resulting people believes that he is me, seems to remember living my life, has my character, and is in every other way psychologically continuous with me. And he has a body that is very like mine.

What could the relevant difference be? One difference is that in the case of Hemisphere Transplant (but not My Division) the psychological connection between the individuals is a non-branching connection. So some psychological theorists say that for you to survive at some later time, you must stand in a certain psychological connection to that thing and to nothing else.
